summary: Iteration 3 — added Stripe checkout (sk_test_emergent), Resend email (empty key → console-log fallback), and env-overridable ElevenLabs voice IDs. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests PASS including 8 new payment/webhook/reset-flow tests. Frontend: Pricing → Stripe Checkout redirect verified; logged-out routing for Starter/Concierge/Pro verified; /app/billing/success error state and 'Still processing' pending fallback both verified visually. Fixed one regression: presenters voice_id was '' because env-overridable voice IDs used os.environ.get(KEY, default) which doesn't apply default for set-but-empty env vars.

minor.issue: Pre-existing: brute-force key uses request.client.host which behind K8s ingress is the proxy IP, splitting attempts across IP buckets (unchanged from iter 2).

integration_issues.issue: Race condition: if the user clicks Pro immediately after navigating to /pricing, AuthContext has not yet resolved /auth/me and `user` is still falsy, so handleTierClick takes the logged-out branch and redirects to /register?next=/pricing instead of calling /api/payments/checkout. Reproduced reliably with no delay; adding a ~3.5s wait before the click makes the Stripe redirect succeed every time. Recommend the button render `disabled` while AuthContext is still in its loading state (e.g., user === undefined), and only enable once user is concretely null or an object.

action_items: Fix Pricing.jsx auth race: render Pro CTA disabled (or show a spinner) while AuthContext is still bootstrapping so an early click does not get bounced to /register?next=/pricing.

(Optional) Add an explicit STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var with documentation so webhook signature verification can succeed in production — current behaviour (400 on missing/invalid signature) is correct but unusable for real Stripe webhook delivery.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: server.py used os.environ.get("ELEVENLABS_VOICE_MIA", "<default>") which returns "" when the env var exists but is empty (as it is in /app/backend/.env). Changed to `os.environ.get(KEY) or "<default>"` for all four presenter voices.
create_checkout correctly persists payment_transactions with payment_status='initiated' and uses server-side authoritative PAYMENT_PACKAGES — frontend cannot inject prices. Good.

checkout_status correctly try/except wraps the Stripe retrieve (sk_test_emergent proxy returns 'No such checkout.session') and falls back to the local txn row → 200 with payment_status='initiated' verified in tests, no 500s.
Webhook handler at /api/webhook/stripe correctly returns 400 (not 500) on empty body and on bad/missing signature — exception is caught and re-raised as HTTPException(400).

send_password_reset_email helper correctly checks RESEND_KEY truthiness and falls back to console log; verified [EMAIL DEV] line in backend.err.log after running test_forgot_password_console_fallback_for_real_user.
Full reset password e2e works: token created → submitted → password updated → login succeeds with new password → token cannot be reused (400 on second submit).
Minor: server.py is now 855 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (auth, payments, studio, projects) at some point.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 24/24 green. Payment tests assume sk_test_emergent proxy cannot retrieve sessions; the test for status assert payment_status='initiated' (not 'paid'). Webhook tests assert 400, not 200. The forgot/reset test reads the token straight from mongo db.password_reset_tokens. Stripe redirect from /pricing was verified live → cs_test_... URL on checkout.stripe.com. The 'Still processing' fallback was screenshotted after 8 polls on a real session ID. Known UX issue: Pricing.jsx Pro button is clickable before AuthContext settles → routes to /register when admin is actually logged in. Worth a one-line fix in Pricing.jsx.

rca_of_the_issue.presenters_empty_voice_id: FIXED. os.environ.get(KEY, DEFAULT) only applies DEFAULT when KEY is absent from os.environ. The .env defined ELEVENLABS_VOICE_MIA="" (intentional placeholder per iteration 3 spec), so KEY is present-but-empty and the default fallback never kicks in → /api/presenters returned voice_id="" for all four presenters, breaking TTS. Changed to `os.environ.get(KEY) or DEFAULT` which evaluates the empty string as falsy and uses the default. Verified via re-running test_presenters_list.
rca_of_the_issue.pricing_pro_race: OPEN. Pricing.jsx handleTierClick reads `user` from useAuth() synchronously. AuthContext initial state is null while /api/auth/me is in-flight; an early click sees null and routes to /register?next=/pricing. Suggested fix: have AuthContext expose an explicit `loading` flag (or use `user === undefined` for loading vs `null` for confirmed-logged-out) and gate the CTA on it.
